transcript_tail.text: Let me check for invisible characters in the actual title field:

Found the bug. Let me explain, fix my session, and offer a follow-up.

## What's going on

**Pattern**: all 4 dup'd titles match `[NICK.host] [NICK.host][SUB] body`. Worker B (clean) has no `[SUB]` — only sessions where the `--subname` or `--sub` tag was set are affected.

**Why it forms** (most likely): there's a race between our titles watcher and Anthropic's platform auto-titler. Between our clean PUT and the watcher's next pass, the platform briefly rewrites the title with some prefix variant. The watcher then sees a form `strip_prefix`'s regex can't fully strip (e.g. with a leading space, or where bracket-groups are space-separated) and prepends `[NICK]` on top.

**Why it doesn't self-heal**: once the dup exists (`[FF.mini] [FF.mini][SUB] body`), `strip_prefix` only consumes the first `[FF.mini] ` and `extract_sub_token` returns None (its regex requires brackets adjacent, not space-separated). `apply_prefix` then returns the same dup'd string verbatim, so the watcher considers it correct and never PUTs a fix.

**Affected sessions** (4 total):
- Mine: `cse_01Dd…sc9M` (FF manager)
- AH sessions: `cse_01Et…yVk4`, `cse_01Jf…m3ns`, `cse_01Vj…UjL` — different agents' sessions, not mine to touch.

Fixing mine now with a clean overwrite via the new `--sub` flag:

## Summary

**Fixed**: my session — now `[FF.mini][MGR-1] Managing 1 worker` (clean). I'll watch it over the next 10–20 min and report if the watcher cycle re-introduces the dup; if it stays clean, the dup was a one-shot race that won't recur for this session.

**Not mine** (3 sessions): the AH-prefixed dups belong to other agents — I shouldn't overwrite another session's title.

**Root-cause fix** (defensive): the real fix is in `ai-harness/remote_control/session_titles.py` — make `strip_prefix` and `extract_sub_token` tolerant of *space-separated* bracket-groups so the watcher can self-heal any dup automatically. A clean implementation is ~10 lines + tests. Until that lands, every new `[SUB]`-tagged session is a candidate for the same race.
Filing the ai-harness ticket and fixing the 2 AH sessions in parallel.
Worker B just reported back — strong report. Recording and surfacing.

## Worker B status — #4 Phase 1 ready to close (your verdict needed)

**Branch / commit**: `feature/loan-shares-urls` @ `eb5880fd`, 1 commit ahead of `origin/main 237aa229` (no rebase needed). Worktree at `.claude/worktrees/issue-4-loan-shares-urls`.

**Diff**: 55 files / +456 / −443. `routes/web.php` is the source of truth (27 paths + 27 route names + 4 redirect rules). Plus 3 controllers, 1 mailer, 16 blade views, 17 Feature tests, 11 Browser tests, 1 golden file, 1 fixture.

**Route caller sweep**: 188 `route('credit_lines.*')` callers across 34 files → **0 remaining**.

**301 redirects** (placed outside auth middleware so bookmarks rewrite before login):
- `/credit-lines/*` → `/loan-shares/*` (root + path catch-all)
- `/accounts/{account}/credit-lines/*` → `/accounts/{account}/loan-shares/*` (per-account + path catch-all)

GET/HEAD only (correct — 301-on-POST is semantically wrong).

**AclMatrix golden** (per `[[reference_route_verb_change_breaks_aclmatrix]]`): 15 keys surgical-edited, top-level re-sorted, no role-key reorder, no status values changed. `AclMatrixTest::test_acl_matrix_critical_routes_match_golden` **passes**.

**Test gate**:

| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| AclMatrix critical-routes | **PASS** (4.2s) |
| AclMatrixTest + SecurityApiAclMatrixTest | **PASS** 13/13 |
| CreditLine* + CrossTenantIsolation + QaBugs20260519/20 | **PASS** 301/301 (1331 assertions / 91s) |
| SmokeTest (incl. nightly route-discovery sweep) | **PASS** 47/47 (574 assertions / 36s) |
| AclMatrixTest::test_acl_matrix_matches_golden (nightly) | **pre-existing drift, NOT this rename** |

The nightly golden drift is on a `configSettings` route added by `3c3e856d` (#40) that was never added to the golden. Worker B's `loan-shares*` entries land at correct alphabetical positions; the diff shows only the `configSettings` row + array-reference renumbering caused by the extra entry.

**Preview env** at `pool0` → `http://localhost:3020`. Curl-grep evidence:
- All 7 old URLs return **301** with `Location` rewritten to `/loan-shares/...`
- All 6 new URLs return **200** under admin
- Section anchors render as `#section-loan-shares` on /accounts/7 and /funds/2
- Beneficiary role-gating unchanged (403 on admin-only, 200 + new anchor on own /accounts/N)

**Section-anchor migration coverage**: `#section-credit-lines` lived in exactly 2 places (accounts/show_ext + funds/show_ext). `grep -rEn "href=['\"]#section-credit-lines"` → 0 callers. Migration sufficient.

## Carry-forward items the worker flagged

1. **`Console/Kernel.php` schedule task names** — `->name('credit_lines.scan_reminders')` (+ 2 more) are Laravel **schedule** identifiers (cron lock keys via `withoutOverlapping()`), not route names. Phase 1 scope = route names, so left for Phase 2.
2. **`RolesAndPermissionsSeeder.php` Spatie permission strings** (`credit-lines.view` etc.) — referenced by `@can()` + policy methods. Coordinated controller-side + migration-side rename needed. Deferred to Phase 2/3.
3. **Artisan command signatures** — `credit-lines:detect-late`, `credit-lines:repair-cancelled-pre-effective`. CLI surface, not URL. Out of scope.
4. **`MismatchAlertMail.php:28`** has a `// Phase 2 TODO: replace with route('loan_shares.resolve', $tran->id)`. Worker updated the literal URL to `/loan-shares/...` (doesn't depend on 301); the TODO comment stays.
5. **UI/code term split confirmed** — kept `/loan-shares/` URL form, did NOT auto-flip to "Share Loan". The new comment in `routes/web.php` uses URL form.
6. **CI .env gotcha** — fresh worktree booted with no `.env`; first AclMatrix run reported 500s ("file_get_contents(/app/.env): Failed") per `[[project_testpool_worktree_needs_env]]`. Fixed locally; flagged for CI image.
